description: Politics isn’t simple—and it shouldn’t be treated like it is. In these videos, I dig into major news stories, local and national bills, and explain not just what’s happening, but why it matters. I’ll break down the real-world consequences, share how I would vote, and talk through the bigger picture—always with honesty, respect, and a commitment to conservative values. No spin, no talking points—just getting into the details that deserve our attention.
title: In The Weeds (VLOG)
